facts.claim: 1-Step has one Challenge phase; 2-Step has Challenge and Verification. They are separate products.
Challenge target is 10% with all positions closed; the subsequent FTMO Account has no profit target.
Daily floor is midnight balance minus 3% of original capital, reset at 00:00 CE(S)T. Equity includes floating P&L, swaps and commissions.
EOD trailing floor uses the highest preceding midnight balance or original capital, minus 10% of original capital. Reward withdrawal and a new account reset the first floor to 90% of initial capital.

Best day must be no more than 50% of the sum of profitable trading-day net closed profits. This differs from total net profit. Exceeding the threshold delays passing or reward eligibility rather than creating a breach.
Challenge target is 10%; Verification target is 5%, with all positions closed. The subsequent FTMO Account has no profit target.
Daily floor is midnight balance minus 5% of original capital, reset at 00:00 CE(S)T. Equity including floating P&L, swaps and commissions is monitored.
Static floor is initial capital minus 10%; monitored equity includes open P&L, swaps and commissions.
Each evaluation phase requires four days when a position is opened, with days measured 00:00–23:59:59 CE(S)T. The FTMO Account has no minimum-day rule.
The comparison lists unlimited periods, no Best Day rule for 2-Step and a 50% rule for 1-Step. 2-Step supports Standard and Swing; 1-Step supports Standard only.
Advertised starting fees are FROM EUR89 for 2-Step and FROM EUR79 for 1-Step. These are not quotes for a configured account, platform, currency or country.
Evaluation fees are one-time, with no recurring fees. The 2-Step fee covers both stages and is refunded with the first Reward under stated conditions; the 1-Step fee is not refunded.
The 1-Step fee is not refunded. The 2-Step fee may be refunded with the first Reward using the original payment method.
A Reward can be requested on the 14th or later day after the first placed trade. Positions and pending orders must be closed. Account review and invoice approval precede payment.
1-Step pays a 90% split without Reward rollover. 2-Step starts at 80%, with 90% conditional on scaling or premium requirements; rollover is available.
Minimum closed profit is USD20 for bank wire and USD50 for cryptocurrency. FTMO states no additional withdrawal commission.
Swing is available exclusively for 2-Step and is unavailable for 1-Step.
Swing removes selected-news, overnight and weekend holding restrictions, while forbidden-practice rules still apply. Standard cannot be changed to Swing after purchase.

Funded Standard prohibits selected-news entries and exits, including pending SL/TP execution, from two minutes before until two minutes after the event. Evaluation and Swing are exempt from this window; forbidden practices remain prohibited.
Funded Standard must close before the weekend or a market break longer than two hours. Evaluation and Swing are exempt. This is not a universal overnight ban.
Algorithmic trading and EAs are permitted conditionally on legitimate, replicable and risk-managed trading. Allocation, hyperactivity and forbidden-practice constraints apply.

Delay or erroneous-feed exploitation and manipulative opposite positions across connected or provider accounts are prohibited. The single-account exception does not permit cross-account payout arbitrage.

Prohibited practices include major-event gap strategies, entering within two hours before a closure of at least two hours, abusive tools, more than 2000 daily server requests and artificial Best Day profit distribution.
Third-party account access or third-party trading for the user is prohibited. A software tool is not authorization to operate a managed account.
VPN and VPS use is generally allowed, with a US-geolocation exception for MetaTrader, cTrader and TradingView. This review did not inspect the location of the current cloud host.
Standard leverage is up to 1:100; Swing is up to 1:30. Exact instrument specifications must be checked in the platform. Server clock and account-rule reset clock are different.
Age 18 or above and region or sanctions restrictions apply. User eligibility cannot be inferred from chat language or timezone.
FTMO Futures Growth and Pro are separate products. CFD 1-Step and 2-Step rules do not describe them. Their configuration-dependent Futures rules are not fully reviewed here.
Trading Combine is a simulated evaluation; one MLL rule and two objectives: target and consistency.
50K/100K/150K targets are $3,000/$6,000/$9,000. Best day cannot exceed 55% of total profit; no rounding or buffer; increased best day raises needed total to best day/0.55.
Passing can take at least two days and 55% is the hard consistency line, without old hidden buffer.
Adjusted total profit needed is best day divided by 0.55; a losing day does not reset best day.
Trading Combine maximum position: 5/10/15 minis, 50/100/150 micros for 50K/100K/150K. 10:1 micro:mini function applies to TC and XFA, not LFA.
Maximum loss allowances are $2,000/$3,000/$4,500 for 50K/100K/150K TC and XFA.
MLL rises with end-of-day balance, never moves down, and locks at starting balance.
MLL calculation updates end-of-day; breach monitoring includes realized and unrealized Net P&L throughout session and triggers immediate liquidation on touch.
XFA begins at $0; 50K MLL starts -$2,000, trails and locks $0 at $2,000 balance.
First XFA payout permanently sets MLL to $0 even if it had not reached zero by trailing.
TC breach means rest-of-day liquidation and funding ineligibility until Reset; XFA breach closes account, with Back2Funded only if eligible.

facts.product_scope: Trading Combine; Express Funded Account; Live Funded Account
facts.claim: TC/XFA DLL is optional; LFA DLL automatic. Hitting DLL is session stop, not MLL rule violation.
Checkout-fixed optional DLL is $1,000/$2,000/$3,000 for 50K/100K/150K, and carries from TC to XFA.
DLL session runs 5 PM CT to 3:10 PM CT; trigger flattens positions, cancels pending orders, blocks trades until next session 5 PM CT.
XFA simulated funded level starts $0, maximum five active accounts, choose Standard or Consistency at activation.
Standard requires five nonconsecutive $150+ Net P&L winning days and $0.01+ net profit since previous payout (first payout exempt).
Consistency requires three trading days with at least one trade per day and largest net winning day <=40% of total net profit.
After requested payout, new consistency window starts next trading day and counts only newly earned profits; request-day trades excluded.

Transferred cumulative balances capped at LFA size split 20% tradable (min $10K) /80% reserve, reserve released in four 25% increments at thresholds.

LFA requires five $150+ winning days per cycle, request <=50% balance without dollar cap. Thirty nonconsecutive $150+ LFA days unlock daily unlocked-balance payouts up to 100%; full withdrawal closes account.
After 30 LFA winning days of $150+, daily unlocked-balance withdrawal allowed (min $125), XFA days excluded.

research_priority.meaning: First contract-fit research candidate for higher-timeframe/overnight conditional EA research, not purchase recommendation or proven EV winner.
conditions: The strategy must pass untouched holdout and forward paper checks.
Exact configured fee and actual instrument or platform costs must be known.
The two-evaluation-phase and Reward model must match the actual product.
User eligibility and the applicable agreement must be established.
The EA must follow forbidden-practice and personal-use rules.
The VPS geolocation exception must be respected.
reasons: Static overall floor and no 1-Step positive-day Best Day denominator simplify research.
Swing permits news, overnight and weekend holding, subject to forbidden-practice rules.
FTMO generally permits conditional VPS use; Topstep prohibits remote order flow.
research_priority.Topstep_alternative: Personal-device intraday futures research only. Cloud research, logs and read-only monitoring are permitted, but order transmission or relay is prohibited. A correct subscription, XFA, scaling and payout model is required.
